uniform_total_stress_audit.single_J_branch: a_internal_ij=(Vj/rho_i)*(Ti+Tj)*g_ij; a_load_ij=(2*q*Vj/rho_i)*g_ij. Ti=Tj=-q*I cancels termwise for arbitrary valid J, apart from actual rounding.
uniform_total_stress_audit.legacy_upw_branch: Effective stress uses mj*(sigma_i/rho_i^2+sigma_j/rho_j^2); pore pressure uses -mj*(pi+pj)/(rho_i*rho_j). Uniform p and sigma_effective=(p-q)*I leave p*mj*(1/rho_i-1/rho_j)^2*g_ij. Equal density or p=0 cancels; do not claim exact general variable-density cancellation.
